name: NIDHI-PRAYAS (prototype grant)
body: DST — NIDHI programme (via PRAYAS centres at TBIs)
summary: The go-to grant for turning an idea into a working prototype — especially hardware. Individuals and students can apply before incorporating a company.
benefits: Up to ₹10 lakh to build a prototype or proof of concept
Mentoring, lab and fabrication access at the host incubator
eligibility: Students, researchers, innovators or early startups with a technology idea
You don't need to be incorporated
Apply to one PRAYAS centre at a time
steps: Find a PRAYAS centre near you on the NIDHI-PRAYAS portal
Apply during its call with a proposal and budget
Pitch to the centre's committee; funds are released in milestones
